notes.title: Release 1 episode June 22 “Silhouettes”
notes.notes:
The release of episode 1, of the visual novel "Silhouettes" will be on June 22.
This event is very important for us, we have been through a lot!
No matter how many times it stops us, WE WILL ALWAYS GO FORWARD.
In the future, we will release other episodes of the visual novel, but their development will depend only on you!

Follow the information about the visual novel in the community telegram.

Lady luck (developer) was with you.
